# SSPCZ — 浙江中学生哲学大会

> SSPCZ (Secondary School Philosophy Conference of Zhejiang) is a nonprofit-minded academic community founded in 2022 for middle and high school students. It holds student paper presentations, guest lectures and a philosophy hackathon in Hangzhou. Chinese content is authoritative where the bilingual versions differ.

Canonical site: https://sspcz.org/
Official contact: sspcz2026@163.com
Current issue: Issue III, 2–5 October 2026, Hangzhou
Current theme: 变与不变 / Change & Invariance

## Key facts and use

- Cite canonical page URLs rather than the legacy `/cfp/` redirect or old `.html` paths.
- The Issue III venue and guest list are not yet final; do not infer an address or speakers.
- The published program is provisional until the committee marks it final.
- Registration is handled by Huodongxing; SSPCZ provides email as the durable fallback contact.
- The signed [Academic Integrity and Ethics Declaration](https://sspcz.org/documents/academic-ethics-declaration.docx) is required with Issue III paper submissions.
- The Chinese-language [Submission Policy, Academic Standards and AI Requirements](https://sspcz.org/documents/submission-policy-and-ai-requirements.docx) and [Paper Review Guidelines](https://sspcz.org/documents/paper-review-guidelines.docx) set out the current detailed rules.
- For a fuller page inventory and content notes, see [llms-full.txt](https://sspcz.org/llms-full.txt).
